name: GraphQL: introspection -> suggestions -> alias amplification -> IDOR
goal: Full schema recovery and object-level extraction on GraphQL surfaces.
preconditions: A GraphQL endpoint (introspection may be off — suggestions still leak).
impact: Complete data-model visibility, then bulk object extraction.

steps.purpose: Dump the schema when introspection is on — every type, field, and relation.
steps.on_success: Build the field/ID map; step 3 for scale.

steps.purpose: Did-you-mean messages leak field names when introspection is disabled.
steps.on_fail: Suggestions off too -> GET/POST/v2 endpoint variants + graphiql UI strings (documented variants).

steps.purpose: One request, hundreds of aliased object fetches — the scale primitive.
steps.on_success: Bulk extraction of any readable type.
steps.on_fail: Batching limited -> persisted-query abuse or query-cost gaps (documented).

steps.purpose: Object-level authz on nodes: swap ids inside node(id:) wrappers.
steps.on_fail: Authz solid -> document schema exposure alone; check mutations for CSRF (csrf shelf).

recon.name: Endpoint matrix
recon.how: Probe method (POST/GET) and path variants; some frameworks expose multiple.

recon.name: IDE fingerprint
recon.how: graphiql/playground/altair UI assets confirm endpoint and let you browse interactively.

recon.name: Suggestion oracle mining
recon.how: Feed nonsense fields, parse 'Did you mean' lists recursively to rebuild schema.

recon.name: Tracing/debug flags
recon.how: apollo-tracing, debug extensions, error paths leak resolver internals.
